def build_langchain_tools(client=None):
    validate_tool_specs()
    try:
        from langchain_core.tools import StructuredTool
    except Exception:
        return [_fallback_descriptor(spec) for spec in TOOL_SPECS]

    tools = []
    for spec in TOOL_SPECS:
        tools.append(StructuredTool.from_function(name=spec.name, func=_callable_for(spec, client)))
    return tools
